name: high mobility group AT-hook 2
pathways: positive regulation of protein serine/threonine kinase activity

function.text: HMGA2 encodes high mobility group protein HMGI-C. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coregulator activity and transcription corepressor activity. It participates in positive regulation of protein serine/threonine kinase activity and chromatin organization.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Silver-Russell syndrome 5 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Carcinoma ex pleomorphic adenoma; Carcinosarcoma of salivary gland; Myoepithelial carcinoma of salivary gland. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
